answer: Every identity pays a 40 POA entry tax into a public vault before earning; locked 20 epochs, refunded only while honest. Forging one identity is like cracking one walnut: tool, time, and effort. A farmer minting 1,000 fakes pays 1,000 x 40 = 40,000 POA; one honest agent pays 40. Sybil accounts flare and vanish like a comet, but the vault never refunds a vanished identity, so the farm's cost stays sunk and honest work keeps its full reward.
